summary: FormForge iteration-2 RBAC + RLS testing: 36/38 backend tests pass (94.7%). All 4 demo accounts seed correctly. /api/auth/menu returns correct role-specific menus (super=16, admin=10, vendor_admin=4, vendor_user=2) and frontend sidebar mirrors it exactly. /api/sites RLS verified (super=3, cluster-mgr admin=Alpha+Bravo, vendor admin/user=Alpha+Charlie). /api/lookup/options + /api/lookup/resolve enforce same row-level scoping (vendor_user blocked from Bravo, allowed on Alpha). /api/submissions: vendor_user only sees own; vendor_admin sees team. /api/forms: assigned_vendor_ids gates visibility AND vendor_user PUT returns 403 (write-guard works). PDF Builder parity: PUT /api/pdf-forms/{id} accepts data_source/lookup/formula on fields (PDFField extra='allow') AND carries assignment fields. PDF UI mounts the shared dlf-tabs component. Iteration-1 regression suite still passes 18/18. TWO REAL BUGS FOUND: the Master Data edit guard is NOT enforced — admin role (rahul.verma) can POST AND PUT /api/sites, when the review_request mandates only super_admin can.

critical.issue: Admin role (non-super) can create sites — returns 200 instead of 403. /app/backend/vendor_routes.py:432 calls _require_admin (allows admin-tier) but should call permissions.require_master_data_editor (super_admin only).

Admin role can update sites — returns 200 instead of 403. Same root cause at /app/backend/vendor_routes.py:438. Also applies to DELETE /api/sites/{id} (line 458) and POST /api/sites/bulk (line 465) which were not directly tested but use the same guard.

minor.issue: Admin role returns 10 menu items (includes 'pdf-submissions') while the review_request listed 9. Functionally correct since pdf-submissions complements pdf-forms; just a spec-vs-impl wording delta. No 'users'/'smtp'/'settings' leakage.

issues: Console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — recharts containers render before parent gets size. Cosmetic but worth a minHeight on the container.

action_items: Fix /app/backend/vendor_routes.py site write endpoints (POST '', PUT/DELETE '/{site_id}', POST '/bulk', POST '/bulk-delete', POST '/import') to use permissions.require_master_data_editor (super_admin only) instead of _require_admin. The helper already exists in /app/backend/permissions.py (line 234).
OPTIONAL: Reconsider whether 'pdf-submissions' should appear in the admin sidebar (review_request lists 9 items without it). Either remove from menu_for(admin) in permissions.py or update the spec.
OPTIONAL: Set a minHeight on the recharts ResponsiveContainer parent on Dashboard to silence the width(-1)/height(-1) warning.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/permissions.py defines require_master_data_editor (line 234) but vendor_routes.py never calls it — dead helper while the guard is missing in practice.

submission_filter for ADMIN (permissions.py:211) only restricts to {'submitted_by': uid}, which is wrong by design: an admin should see submissions for forms they own/are-assigned-to, not just ones they personally submitted. server.py compensates by computing visible form_ids inline (line 454-456), so the helper itself is misleading — consider removing or aligning the helper.

PDFField uses extra='allow' (pdf_routes.py:66) which is correct for parity, but the validate-field-types loop (line 521) still rejects unknown 'type' values — fine for now, just ensure builder always emits one of PDF_FIELD_TYPES.
site_filter (permissions.py:118-119) wraps vendor_email match around the first clause via index mutation — fragile if future code re-orders clauses. Consider building the OR list explicitly.

form_filter (permissions.py:147) returns {'form_id':'__none__'} when an admin has no uid (impossible in practice, but the same pattern is used elsewhere as a 'deny-all' filter — document the convention).

success_rate.backend: 94.7% (36/38 pytest — 18/18 iter-1 regression + 18/20 iter-2; 2 failures are real Master-Data-guard bugs)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (sidebar menus match /api/auth/menu spec for all 4 roles; dlf-tabs component mounted in PDF builder)

seed_data_creation: Test creates+deletes TEST_RBAC_* forms inline (cleaned up). The two failing master-data-guard tests now self-heal (delete leaked site / revert leaked plant_name) so reruns are idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run only `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_rbac_rls.py::TestMasterDataGuard -v` after main agent swaps _require_admin->require_master_data_editor in vendor_routes.py. All other 36 tests already pass. Frontend sidebar verification was done with Playwright by logging into all 4 demo accounts — no need to re-do unless menu_for() changes.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the 2 backend failures: /app/backend/vendor_routes.py uses an internal helper `_require_admin` (admin-tier check) for all site write endpoints. The review_request mandates that Master Data writes are super_admin-only. The correct helper `require_master_data_editor` already exists in /app/backend/permissions.py:234 but is currently unused. Reproduction: login as rahul.verma@example.com -> POST /api/sites returns 200 (should be 403); PUT /api/sites/{id} returns 200 (should be 403). Mitigation: replace `await _require_admin(user)` with `from permissions import require_master_data_editor; require_master_data_editor(user)` in create_site, update_site, delete_site, bulk_upsert, bulk_delete and import endpoints in vendor_routes.py.
